items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: George Jackson's piano... we used to play every weekend

ctx.x: Uh, Sylvester Trumpet, Octave Bass, the other piano.
George Jackson's piano, and who was playing saxophone or clarinet?
I don't think we had a saxophone. They probably were just the four of us. Well, we booked a little job down in Gulfport, there, where we used to play every weekend. Well, hold it.
